preExecutionNotes: All entities, accounts, holdings, bills, cards, subscriptions, query grants, funds and obligation records are synthetic and built in each fixture context. Labels were manually written from the visible context and phase7 contract; no planner, resolver, scorer result or model output generated expected values. Before any G7 run, schema preflight found unsupported BillCategory 文化 in the bookshop transaction; corrected only its category to supported 购物 and aligned the g705 query wording. No execution occurred before this correction. Previous preflight fixture SHA256 was 31cb96eeae6aebc7a0ab8b2cfbb68cdfde6e15cdc884e3276dcc70d68cdaf8d0.

Bill cases with positive evidence provide a matching 2026-09 or 2026-10 report and transaction IDs. The cross-month comparison supplies only September and must clarify; the 2025-12 query supplies no report and must not invent data.

Funds previews use the same account ID, balance and reserve as the synthetic account. Goal funding case g722 references the exact T+0 position, redemption amount is within available position, and target amount/date are explicit. g724 provides zero-amount funds preview for a read-only protected-spendable query.

Alias and ambiguity labels use only aliases explicitly present in context. Card changes use exact card names/tail values; unsupported product alias, quote-only request, and missing conversation history are labeled for safe clarification/no action.
The live sample is preselected at two cases per domain before any execution. This set has not been run and becomes seen regression data after first execution.
